request.state: An unimplemented company workflow DSL must support switching from external SaaS without inventing provenance. Company P has 2,000 historical expense records and 2,000 receipts with employee-own and scoped finance access. Company W has 20,000 bookings and 5,000 invoices requiring preserved customer and booking/invoice links; external accounting, payments and identity continue separately. Existing CSV review calls canonical operations, limits each review to 1,000 rows/10MiB, uses explicit reference choices, rechecks duplicate candidates, and commits rows independently with stable retry identities. Files require same-principal intent/upload/finalize and final attach checks; CSV paths or opaque IDs confer no authority. Existing Expense create makes claimant-owned drafts, decide records the actual current reviewer and current timestamp, and reimbursement requires a real approved claim/current finance and records current attribution while allowing an evidenced past payment date. Locked decisions and reserved metadata cannot be filled by CSV. Installed-schema backfill maps an exact installed predecessor and is not external population. Current authorized steward scenarios can create ordinary typed immutable evidence records with source keys, claimed historical actor/date/status, finalized source documents and separately evidenced optional links to current accounts. Missing past accounts must not be provisioned as fictitious users. Historical claims must remain distinguishable from Can approval/payment events. Unknown outcomes, invalid files, duplicates, partial imports and retained-file access need explicit disposition. No universal raw-write importer, new archive application, implementation benchmark or assumed vendor export fidelity exists. Evaluate the complete routes below against faithful history, current access, future workflow continuity and real mapping/support/archive costs.

intake.instructions: Which route best satisfies the stated historical preservation and adoption requirements as a bounded draft contract?

criteria.domain_intake: Add bounded historical constructors to the owning expense/booking/invoice domains. They accept only supported evidenced historical state with verified person/reference mappings and explicit current-steward attestation, preserving distinct imported provenance; unsupported rows stay in the old system. They make supported history available in domain reports, but require each domain to define past-state validity and prevent hooks/provider effects; missing actors and unresolved evidence reduce coverage and can retain SaaS costs.
criteria.evidence_records: Keep historical facts in ordinary immutable typed evidence records within their owning packages, linked to source documents and explicitly mapped current accounts/customer/booking references. Record historical claims without producing live approved/paid state; future work uses canonical business operations. This can preserve unverified/missing actors as text and explicit incompleteness, but requires reviewed mapping, archive/live reporting distinction, attachment storage and possibly retained originals for unsupported files.
criteria.retained_source: Preserve the original system or an access-controlled exported archive as historical authority and link authorized users to it from the owning Can views; import only current actionable records through normal operations. This avoids reinterpreting old states and many file mappings, but company access/export retention, old-system availability, separate reporting and continuing archive/subscription/support costs must be maintained.
